item.title: Third-term lawmaker Han Byeong-do re-elected as Democratic Party floor leader (3선 한병도, 민주당 원내대표 연임)
item.description:
Third-term lawmaker Han Byeong-do re-elected as Democratic Party floor leader (3선 한병도, 민주당 원내대표 연임)

Third-term lawmaker Han Byeong-do (59, Iksan-eul, Jeonbuk) was appointed as the new floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea on the 6th. Floor Leader Han was elected as floor leader in January after his predecessor, Kim Byeong-gi, resigned amid allegations of nomination bribes, and he successfully secured a second term by running unopposed in this election. <<> Regarding the "fabricated indictment" special counsel law, which would allow the withdrawal of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung's case, Floor Leader Han stated, "Uncovering the truth and achieving judicial recovery through a special counsel is something the Democratic Party must do," adding, "As for the timing, procedure, and content of the process, we will gather opinions from the public and party members after the local elections and make a judgment after going through a full deliberation process." Previously, the Democratic Party had sought to handle the special counsel law before the elections, but President Lee blocked it. <<> Floor Leader Han is expected to soon begin discussions on forming the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. He has criticized the pace of legislative progress in standing committees chaired by the People Power Party, arguing that the ruling party could take all 17 standing committee chair positions. In particular, he insists that the Democratic Party must take control of the key Legislation and Judiciary Committee. <<> The People Power Party will also elect a new floor leader around early to mid-June, when Floor Leader Song Eon-seok's term ends. Candidates being considered include four-term lawmaker Kim Do-eup and three-term lawmakers Seong Il-jong and Jeong Jeom-sik. (더불어민주당 새 원내대표로 3선 한병도(59·전북 익산을) 의원이 6일 추대됐다. 한 원내대표는 지난 1월 김병기 전 원내대표가 공천 헌금 의혹으로 사퇴하면서 원내대표로 선출됐고, 이번 선거에서 단독 입후보해 연임에 성공했다.)

item.title: Lee Targets PPP, Which Boycotts Constitutional Amendment Vote: "Must Be Viewed as Supporting Illegal Martial Law" (李, 개헌 표결 불참 국힘 겨냥 “불법 계엄 옹호한다고 봐야”)
item.description:
Lee Targets PPP, Which Boycotts Constitutional Amendment Vote: "Must Be Viewed as Supporting Illegal Martial Law" (李, 개헌 표결 불참 국힘 겨냥 “불법 계엄 옹호한다고 봐야”)

As the National Assembly attempts a vote for or against a constitutional amendment led by the Democratic Party of Korea on the 7th, President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 6th, "We want to prevent illegal martial law from happening again. Which citizen would oppose that? Shouldn't those who oppose be seen as advocates of illegal martial law?" This was interpreted as a jab at the People Power Party (PPP), which is pushing for discussions on constitutional amendments after the June 3 local elections. The PPP is known to be boycotting the vote on the amendment. In that case, the vote is likely to fail due to lack of quorum. <<> Chairing a cabinet meeting at the presidential office that day, President Lee said, "Even without a state of martial law, declaring martial law illegally for the purpose of maintaining power or personal gain, and using the military to ruin the country and pursue dictatorship—isn't it only natural to prevent this?" He added, "So, we propose inserting reasonable controls over emergency martial law into the Constitution. Who would oppose that?" He also stated, "The vote on the constitutional amendment, which has no reason for opposition, is on the 7th. It's a rare opportunity that has been long in the making. It would be good if all citizens agree and if all political factions act on what they have long unanimously called for." <<> Previously, on the 3rd of last month, 187 lawmakers from six parliamentary parties—including the Democratic Party, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—along with independents, proposed a constitutional amendment. The amendment includes enshrining the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratic Uprising in the Constitution's preamble, as well as strengthening requirements for martial law. <<> That day, PPP representative Jang Dong-hyuk met with reporters at the National Assembly and said, "National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik visited the party leader's office to discuss the constitutional amendment issue." He added, "We told him that discussing constitutional amendments while pushing for the cancellation of prosecutions and an unconstitutional special counsel investigation to erase President Lee Jae-myung's crimes is not appropriate." He also said, "What's the point of amending the Constitution? We told him that people who have no intention of respecting the constitutional spirit or upholding the Constitution, what would they do with an amendment?" For the amendment to pass, at least 12 PPP lawmakers would need to vote in favor, but the PPP plans to boycott the vote as party policy. (국회가 7일 더불어민주당 주도로 개헌안 찬반 표결을 시도하는 가운데, 이재명 대통령이 6일 “불법 계엄을 더 이상 못하게 하자는데, 어떤 국민이 반대하겠냐. 반대하는 사람들은 불법계엄 옹호론자라고 봐야하지 않겠냐”라고 했다. 6·3 지방선거 후 개헌을 논의하자는 국민의힘을 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다. 국민의힘은 개헌안 표결에 불참할 것으로 알려졌다. 이 경우 투표 불성립으로 개헌안 표결은 무산될 전망이다.)

item.title: PPP Candidates from Yeongnam Region: "The President Is Not a King" (국힘 영남권 후보들 “대통령은 왕 아니다”)
item.description:
PPP Candidates from Yeongnam Region: "The President Is Not a King" (국힘 영남권 후보들 “대통령은 왕 아니다”)

The People Power Party (PPP) on Wednesday focused its efforts on criticizing the "fabricated indictment" special counsel bill, which would enable the dismissal of charges in President Lee Jae-myung’s case. Lawmakers held a rally against the special counsel bill that day, stating, "The Democratic Party might as well adopt the dismissal of charges as its campaign promise." Candidates for metropolitan and provincial governors in the Yeongnam region also held a press conference denouncing the special counsel bill, criticizing, "President Lee is not the king of the Republic of Korea." (국민의힘은 6일 이재명 대통령 사건의 공소 취소를 가능하게 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안 비판에 당력을 집중했다. 의원들은 이날 특검법 규탄 대회를 열고 “민주당은 차라리 공소 취소를 공약으로 걸라”고 했다. 영남권 시·도지사 후보들도 특검법 규탄 기자회견을 열어 “이 대통령은 대한민국의 왕이 아니다”라고 비판했다.)

PPP lawmakers held a rally at the National Assembly that day to denounce the Democratic Party’s push for the fabricated indictment special counsel bill. Floor Leader Song Eon-seok said, "A powerful figure like the president is mobilizing all his authority to completely erase his criminal record," and added, "(The Democratic Party) might as well honestly run in this local election with a promise to dismiss the charges and face the people’s judgment." (국민의힘 의원들은 이날 국회에서 민주당의 조작 기소 특검법 추진에 대한 규탄 대회를 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 “대통령이라는 권력자가 자신의 권력을 총동원해 본인의 범죄 기록을 깡그리 지워버리려고 하고 있다”며 “(민주당은) 차라리 이번 지방선거에 정정당당하게 공소 취소하겠다는 공약을 걸고 국민적 심판을 받으라”고 했다.)

According to the special counsel bill proposed by the Democratic Party on the 30th of last month, this special counsel would investigate 12 cases, including President Lee’s violation of the Public Official Election Act and the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case, and could take over cases currently on trial to decide whether to maintain the indictment. (민주당이 지난달 30일 발의한 특검법에 따르면 이번 특검은 이 대통령 공직선거법 위반 사건, 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 등 12개 사건을 수사하고, 재판 중인 사건까지 넘겨받아 공소 유지 여부를 결정할 수 있다.)

Immediately after the rally, the PPP held a general meeting of lawmakers and listened to a lecture by Ji Seong-woo, a professor at Sungkyunkwan University’s Law School. Professor Ji said, "This is an unprecedented bad law in world history," and noted, "Not only (President Lee) himself but also accomplices in the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool cases could have their charges dismissed." The PPP plans to hold a Supreme Council meeting in front of the presidential office on Thursday to continue its fight against the opposition, including denouncing the special counsel bill. (국민의힘은 규탄 대회 직후 의원 총회를 열고 지성우 성균관대 법학전문대학원 교수의 강연을 들었다. 지 교수는 “세계 역사상 유례없는 악법”이라며 “본인(이 대통령)뿐 아니라 대장동·쌍방울 사건 등의 공범들도 공소 취소가 될 수 있다”고 했다. 국민의힘은 7일 청와대 앞에서 최고위원 회의를 열고 특검법 규탄 등 대여 투쟁을 이어갈 예정이다.)

Candidates from the PPP for metropolitan and provincial governors in Daegu, North Gyeongsang, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang also held a joint press conference at Ulsan City Hall that day, titled "Denouncing the Dismissal of Charges Special Counsel Bill." The candidates said, "President Lee is not the king of the Republic of Korea" and "If the special counsel bill passes, exercise the veto." There is widespread analysis that the fabricated indictment special counsel issue is significantly impacting public sentiment in the Yeongnam region elections, where candidates from the ruling and opposition parties are neck and neck. (국민의힘 대구·경북·부산·울산·경남 시·도지사 후보들도 이날 울산시청에서 ‘공소 취소 특검법 규탄’ 공동 기자회견을 열었다. 후보들은 “이 대통령은 대한민국의 왕이 아니다” “특검법이 통과되면 거부권을 행사하라”라고 했다. 조작 기소 특검법 이슈는 특히 여야 후보 간 백중세를 보이는 영남 선거 민심에 큰 영향을 미치고 있다는 분석이 많다.)

PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk attended the Gyeonggi Province Party’s victory rally that day and said, "This local election will be one that judges the Democratic Party, a criminal organization, and its ringleader, Lee Jae-myung." Regarding Democratic Party candidate for Gyeonggi Governor, Choo Mi-ae, he said, "She is the stormtrooper and queen of destruction who followed Lee Jae-myung’s orders to dismantle the prosecution and destroy the judiciary." A source from the opposition party said, "It appears that party leader Jang is focusing on attacking the opposition given that candidates are not welcoming his on-site campaign support." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 경기도당 필승 결의대회에 참석해 “이번 지방선거는 범죄 단체인 민주당과 그 수괴인 이재명을 심판하는 선거가 될 것”이라고 했다. 그는 민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보에 대해선 “이재명 명령을 좇아 검찰을 해체하고 사법부를 파괴한 돌격 대장, 파괴 여왕”이라고 했다. 야권 관계자는 “후보들이 장 대표의 현장 유세 지원을 달가워하지 않는 상황에서 장 대표가 대여 공세에 집중하는 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Surpassing Kim Il-sung? Large-Scale Deletion of Predecessors' Achievements from Constitutional Preamble (김일성 뛰어넘는 김정은? 헌법 서문에 선대 업적 대거 삭제)
item.description:
Kim Jong-un Surpassing Kim Il-sung? Large-Scale Deletion of Predecessors' Achievements from Constitutional Preamble (김일성 뛰어넘는 김정은? 헌법 서문에 선대 업적 대거 삭제)

In the preamble of North Korea's new constitution released on the 6th, most of the achievements of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il, which were extensively described in the previous constitution, have been deleted, and Kim Jong-un's ruling ideology of "people-first principle" has been explicitly stated. This is analyzed as part of a "erasing predecessors" campaign aimed at strengthening Kim Jong-un's status. (6일 공개된 북한 새 헌법 서문에서 기존 헌법에 길게 서술돼 있던 김일성과 김정일의 업적이 대부분 삭제되고, 김정은의 통치 이념인 ‘인민 대중 제일주의’가 명기됐다. 김정은의 위상 강화 차원에서 진행돼 온 ‘선대(先代) 지우기’의 일환이라는 분석이 나온다.)

North Korea deleted all the achievements of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il, which were detailed in over a dozen items in the previous constitution, from the preamble of the new constitution revised at the Supreme People's Assembly in March. Phrases such as Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il having realized the "cause of national reunification" have disappeared, and the previous constitution's four instances of stating that they had built "immortal achievements" were not included in the new constitution. Only the sentence setting "the whole society's Kim Il-sung-Kim Jong-il-ism" as a goal remains in the revised preamble. While achievements belong to the predecessors as individuals, "Kim Il-sung-Kim Jong-il-ism" is a form of ideology, and the authority to interpret and inherit that ideology lies with the current leader, Kim Jong-un. <<> Since the start of this year, Kim Jong-un has been highlighting himself as a "new-era leader" distinct from his predecessors. At the 9th Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea held in February, Party Secretary Ri Il-hwan proposed electing Kim Jong-un as general secretary, stating that with his "extraordinary and outstanding leadership," he had "achieved great victories clearly distinct from the 75 years after liberation and ushered in a new era." In North Korea, badges exclusively featuring Kim Jong-un began appearing in 2024, and Ri Il-hwan was seen wearing one. <<> In his closing speech at the party congress, Kim Jong-un also described his achievements as "not the result of the passage of time, but brilliant outcomes obtained by accelerating time according to the people's will and aspirations." He also characterized the discourse of inter-Korean reconciliation and cooperation from the Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il eras as a "misguided past" and stated that he had "thoroughly liquidated the outdated notions and remnants of past relics." <<> In November last year, the National Intelligence Service stated at a parliamentary audit that "Kim Jong-un is engaging in an independent idolization campaign to build a ruling foundation that surpasses his predecessors Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il." North Korea has recently rarely used the term "Day of the Sun" to commemorate Kim Il-sung's birthday (April 15), and Kim Jong-un has skipped the visit to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, which he used to make every year on his grandfather's birthday, for four consecutive years including this year. (북한은 지난 3월 최고인민회의에서 개정한 새 헌법 서문에서 기존 헌법에 10여 개 항목에 걸쳐 자세히 기술돼 있던 김일성·김정일의 업적을 모두 삭제했다. 김일성·김정일이 ‘조국 통일 위업’을 실현했다는 표현이 사라졌고, 기존 헌법에는 김일성·김정일이 ‘불멸의 업적’을 쌓았다는 문구가 네 차례나 등장했지만 새 헌법에는 포함되지 않았다. 개정 헌법 서문에는 ‘온 사회의 김일성-김정일주의화’를 목표로 한다는 문장만 남았다. 업적은 선대 개인의 것이지만 ‘김일성-김정일주의’는 일종의 사상으로, 그 사상을 해석하고 계승하는 권한은 현 지도자인 김정은에게 있다.)

item.title: Government Calls for 'Step-by-Step, Practical Approach' to Denuclearization of Korean Peninsula at NPT Meeting (정부는 NPT 회의서 “한반도 비핵화 목표에 단계적·실용적 접근”)
item.description:
Government Calls for 'Step-by-Step, Practical Approach' to Denuclearization of Korean Peninsula at NPT Meeting (정부는 NPT 회의서 “한반도 비핵화 목표에 단계적·실용적 접근”)

Amid reports that North Korea’s newly revised constitution in March explicitly includes Chairman Kim Jong-un’s authority over nuclear forces for the first time, the South Korean government continues to emphasize a 'step-by-step, practical' approach toward denuclearization. The strategy involves beginning with a freeze on North Korea’s nuclear program, moving to reduce nuclear weapons, and ultimately pursuing the long-term goal of the 'denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula' through a three-phase approach. (북한이 지난 3월 개정한 새 헌법에 김정은 국무위원장의 ‘핵무력 지휘권’을 최초로 명시한 것으로 알려진 가운데, 우리 정부는 연일 비핵화를 위한 ‘단계적·실용적' 접근을 강조하고 있다. 북핵의 동결로 시작해 핵무기를 축소하고, 장기적으로 ‘한반도의 비핵화’란 목표로 나아가는 3단계 접근법을 지속하겠다는 취지다.)

The government held a meeting on the 5th (local time) at the United Nations headquarters in New York, co-hosted with the French government, under the theme 'Addressing North Korea’s Nuclear Challenges and Upholding the Integrity of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).' In his opening remarks, Ha Wi-young, Director-General for International Security at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, stated that “tactics may change depending on the situation, but the goal remains unchanged,” reaffirming the commitment to the goal of 'complete denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula.' Director Ha added, “It is because this clear goal exists that flexible strategies, such as a step-by-step approach, become possible,” and emphasized that “diplomatic opportunities for denuclearization will surely come, so it is important to prepare in advance.” Kim Sang-jin, Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations, who participated as a panelist, introduced the step-by-step, practical approach, reflecting the reality where North Korea rejects dialogue amid the advancement of its nuclear program and the growing military ties between North Korea and Russia. (정부는 5일(현지 시각) 미국 뉴욕 유엔본부에서 프랑스 정부와 공동으로 ‘북핵 도전과 핵확산금지조약(NPT)의 완결성 수호’를 주제로 회의를 열었다. 하위영 외교부 국제안보국장은 개회사에서 “상황에 따라 전술은 변할 수 있지만 목표는 변하지 않는다”면서 ‘한반도의 완전한 비핵화’ 목표를 견지한다고 밝혔다. 하 국장은 “이렇듯 분명한 목표가 있기 때문에 비로소 단계별 접근과 같은 유연한 전략이 가능해진 것”이라며 “비핵화를 위한 외교적 기회는 반드시 찾아올 것인 만큼 미리 준비해 두는 것이 중요하다”고 했다. 패널로 참석한 김상진 주유엔대표부 차석대사는 북핵 고도화와 북·러 군사 밀착 상황에서 북한이 대화를 거부하는 현실을 반영한 단계적·실용적 접근 방식을 소개했다.)

Earlier, President Lee Jae-myung, in his New Year’s press conference, questioned whether North Korea would give up its nuclear weapons and proposed a first phase of 'suspension' followed by negotiations on 'arms reduction.' Reflecting this stance, the current government has been primarily using the term 'complete denuclearization (CD)' instead of 'complete, verifiable, and irreversible dismantlement (CVID)' of North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs, as specified in UN Security Council resolutions. (앞서 이재명 대통령은 올해 신년 기자회견에서 북핵 문제와 관련해 “북한이 핵을 포기하겠나”라며 1단계 ‘중단’에 이은 ‘군축’ 협상을 제안했다. 이런 기조를 반영해 현 정부에선 유엔 안전보장이사회 대북 결의에 명시된 북핵·미사일의 ‘완전하고 검증 가능하며 되돌릴 수 없는 폐기(CVID)’ 대신 ‘완전한 비핵화(CD)’라는 표현을 주로 사용하고 있다.)

Sharon Squassoni, a research professor at George Washington University who attended the meeting, argued that while maintaining the long-term goal of denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula, the short-term focus should be on 'risk reduction' to prevent nuclear war. Specifically, she suggested that the four parties—the United States, China, Russia, and North Korea—should simultaneously ratify the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), banning all nuclear tests and strengthening verification systems, to lead international norms for halting nuclear tests. (이날 회의에 참석한 샤론 스콰소니 미 조지워싱턴대 연구교수는 장기적인 한반도 비핵화 목표를 유지하되, 단기적으로는 핵전쟁 방지를 위한 ‘위험 감소’에 집중해야 한다고 했다. 특히 미·중·러·북 4자가 모든 핵실험을 금지하고 검증 체계를 강화하는 포괄적핵실험금지조약(CTBT)을 동시에 비준해 국제 핵실험 중단 규범을 주도해야 한다고 했다.)

South Korea and France have co-hosted side events addressing North Korea’s nuclear issues alongside NPT review conferences since 2017, and this event was held in conjunction with the 11th NPT review conference. (한국과 프랑스는 2017년부터 NPT 평가회의에 맞춰 북핵 문제를 다루는 부대행사를 공동 주최해 왔으며, 이날도 제11차 NPT 회의에 맞춰 열렸다.)

item.title: North Korea Specifies Kim Jong Un’s Right to Use Nuclear Weapons in Constitution (北, 헌법에 ‘김정은 핵사용권’ 명시)
item.description:
North Korea Specifies Kim Jong Un’s Right to Use Nuclear Weapons in Constitution (北, 헌법에 ‘김정은 핵사용권’ 명시)

It was confirmed on the 6th that North Korea, in its new constitution amended during the Supreme People’s Assembly in March, has for the first time specified Chairman Kim Jong Un’s authority to use nuclear weapons and significantly strengthened his powers. North Korea also added new territorial provisions effectively designating the inter-Korean truce line as a “border line,” while deleting articles and expressions related to “unification.” This reflects Kim Jong Un’s doctrine of “two-state relations” between the two Koreas, which he has advocated since late last year. However, hostile expressions such as “belligerent relations” and “pacification of all South Korean territory,” used by Kim at the time, were not included in the constitution. (북한이 지난 3월 최고인민회의에서 개정한 새 헌법에 김정은 국무위원장의 핵 사용 권한을 처음으로 명시하고, 김정은의 권한을 대폭 강화한 것으로 6일 확인됐다. 북한은 또 남북 간의 휴전선을 사실상 ‘국경선’으로 설정하는 영토 조항을 신설하면서, ‘통일’ 관련 조항과 표현은 삭제했다. 김정은이 2023년 말부터 제시한 남북 ‘두 국가 관계론’을 헌법에 반영한 것이다. 다만 김정은이 당시 사용한 “교전국 관계” “남조선 전 영토 평정” 등의 적대적 표현은 헌법에 담기지 않았다.)

Article 2 of North Korea’s new constitution, unveiled at a press briefing for the Unification Ministry’s press corps on this day, defines North Korea’s territory as “the territory bordering the People’s Republic of China and the Russian Federation to the north and the Republic of Korea to the south, along with the territorial sea and airspace established on that basis.” For the first time, a territorial provision absent in the previous constitution was newly established, with North Korea stating that “any infringement on the territory will never be tolerated.” (이날 통일부 기자단 언론간담회에서 공개된 북한의 새 헌법 2조는 북한의 영역을 “북쪽으로 중화인민공화국과 러시아연방, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있는 영토와 그에 기초해 설정된 영해와 영공”으로 규정했다. 기존 헌법에 없던 영토 규정을 최초로 신설하며 북한은 “영역에 대한 그 어떤 침해도 절대로 허용하지 않는다”고 했다.)

The previous Article 9 of North Korea’s constitution, which contained clauses about “strengthening the people’s government in the northern half” and “struggling to achieve the unification of the fatherland,” was deleted. The so-called “Three Principles of National Unification”—independence, peaceful unification, and great national unity—were also removed. In his policy address at the Supreme People’s Assembly in January 2024, Kim Jong Un stated that “expressions like ‘independence, peaceful unification, and great national unity’ in the constitution should now be deleted,” and this was fully reflected. (기존 북한 헌법 9조에는 “북반부에서 인민정권을 강화”하고 “조국 통일을 실현하기 위해 투쟁한다”는 조항이 있었지만 삭제됐다. ‘자주, 평화통일, 민족대단결’의 이른바 ‘조국 통일 3대 원칙’도 함께 삭제됐다. 김정은은 2024년 1월 최고인민회의 시정연설에서 “헌법에 있는 ‘자주·평화통일·민족대단결’이라는 표현들이 이제는 삭제돼야 한다”고 했는데, 그대로 반영된 것이다.)

Article 89 of North Korea’s new constitution includes a newly established clause stating that “the command authority over nuclear forces lies with the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission.” A provision allowing the Chairman to delegate the right to use nuclear weapons to the “State Nuclear Force Command Organ” was also added, interpreted as preparation for Kim Jong Un’s overseas visits. Article 90 includes a new clause granting the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission the “right to veto” laws adopted by the Supreme People’s Assembly. (북한의 새 헌법 89조에는 “핵무력에 대한 지휘권은 국무위원장에게 있다”는 조항이 신설됐다. 국무위원장이 ‘국가핵무력지휘기구’에 핵 사용권을 위임할 수 있다는 조항도 신설돼, 김정은의 해외 방문 등에 대비했다는 해석이 나온다. 90조에는 국무위원장이 최고인민회의가 채택한 법령에 대해 ‘거부권’을 행사할 수 있다는 조항이 신설됐다.)

◇“Bordering South Korea to the South” Solidifies Truce Line as Border (◇“남으로 대한민국과 접해” 휴전선을 국경선으로 못박아)

Article 1 of North Korea’s new constitution, released on the 6th, stipulates the state name as “the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea.” This is a provision for the state name that did not exist in the previous constitution. North Korea established territorial provisions for the first time in Article 2, and placed provisions on citizenship status in Article 3. The constitution’s title, previously “Socialist Constitution,” was also changed to “Constitution.” (6일 공개된 북한의 새 헌법 1조는 “우리나라의 국호는 조선민주주의인민공화국”이란 국호 규정이다. 기존 북한 헌법에 없던 국호 규정을 만든 것이다. 북한은 2조에 영토 규정을 처음 신설했고, 3조에는 공민 자격에 대한 조항을 배치했다. ‘사회주의 헌법’이었던 헌법의 명칭도 ‘헌법’으로 바꿨다.)

Professor Lee Jung-chul of Seoul National University’s Department of Political Science and International Relations, who conducted the press briefing for the Unification Ministry’s press corps on this day as a ministry advisor, commented that “overall, this appears to be an effort to normalize North Korea as a state,” and “it seems to aim for a form similar to the constitutions of other countries.” (통일부 자문위원으로 이날 통일부 기자단 언론간담회를 진행한 이정철 서울대 정치외교학과 교수는 이에 대해 “전반적으로 북한을 정상국가화하는 차원”에서 “다른 나라들 헌법과 유사한 형태를 띠는 쪽으로 변화를 꾀한 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

In his policy address at the Supreme People’s Assembly in January 2024, North Korean Chairman Kim Jong Un said, “It is important to reflect in the constitution the issue of completely occupying, pacifying, and reclaiming the Republic of Korea and incorporating it into the territory of the Republic in the event of war.” He also stated, “It is right to explicitly stipulate in the articles that the Republic of Korea should be thoroughly regarded as the primary hostile state and an unchangeable principal enemy.” (김정은 북한 국무위원장은 2024년 1월 최고인민회의 시정연설에서 “헌법에 ‘전쟁이 일어나는 경우에는 대한민국을 완전히 점령·평정·수복하고 공화국 영역에 편입시키는 문제’를 반영하는 것이 중요하다”고 말했다. “대한민국을 철두철미 제1의 적대국으로, 불변의 주적으로 확고히 간주하는 것을 조문에 명기하는 것이 옳다”고도 했다.)

The revised North Korean constitution disclosed this time does not include such clauses explicitly stating hostile relations. However, this does not necessarily mean that Kim Jong Un’s stance on inter-Korean relations being “belligerent relations during wartime” has changed. Professor Lee Jung-chul assessed that “North Korea likely judged it inappropriate to use harsh language in its supreme document.” There is also a possibility that they adjusted the tone with future changes in relations with the United States in mind. (이번에 공개된 북한의 개정 헌법에 이처럼 적대 관계를 명시하는 조항은 포함되지 않았다. 그렇다고 해서 남북이 “전쟁 중인 교전국 관계”라는 김정은의 입장이 달라졌다는 뜻은 아니라는 평가가 나온다. 이정철 교수는 “북한도 자국의 최고 문서에 험한 표현을 쓰는 것은 적절치 않다고 판단한 것 같다”고 했다. 앞으로 미국과의 관계 변화 등을 염두에 두고 수위를 조절했을 가능성도 있다.)

Although North Korea stated that its territory “borders China and Russia to the north and the Republic of Korea to the south,” it did not specify the boundaries of its territorial sea and airspace in the constitution. North Korea denies the Northern Limit Line (NLL), the inter-Korean maritime boundary set by the United Nations Command in 1953, claiming that areas including the five West Sea islands such as Yeonpyeongdo and Baengnyeongdo are within its waters. In February 2024, Kim Jong Un described the NLL as a “phantom line with no international legal basis or legitimate justification.” (북한은 자국 영토가 ‘북쪽으로 중·러, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있다’고 했지만, 영해와 영공의 경계선은 헌법에 명시하지 않았다. 북한은 1953년 유엔군사령관이 설정한 남북 간 해상 경계선인 북방한계선(NLL)을 부정하며, 연평도와 백령도 등 서해 5도 일대가 모두 북측 수역에 포함된다고 주장하고 있다. 김정은은 2024년 2월 NLL이 “국제법적 근거나 합법적 명분도 없는 유령선(幽靈線)”이라고 했다.)

Consequently, there were concerns that North Korea might establish territorial sea provisions in the constitution to neutralize the NLL in the West Sea, but this was not included in the revision. Yang Moo-jin, a professor at the University of North Korean Studies, stated, “Given that the current inter-Korean land and maritime boundaries are based on the Armistice Agreement, this is understood as an inevitable choice to avoid international legal disputes.” (이 때문에 북한이 헌법에 영해 조항을 신설해 서해 NLL 무력화에 나설 것이란 우려가 있었으나, 이번 개정에 포함되지 않았다. 양무진 북한대학원대학 석좌교수는 “현재 남북 간 육상·해상 경계선은 정전협정에 근거하고 있는 만큼 국제법적 논란을 일으키지 않으려는 불가피한 선택으로 이해된다”고 말했다.)

One feature of North Korea’s new constitution is the overall significant reinforcement of Kim Jong Un’s powers. In the previous constitution, matters concerning the Supreme People’s Assembly, the nominal highest sovereign body, were placed in Section 1 of the state organs, while provisions on the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, held by Kim, were in Section 2. In the new constitution, this order was reversed, placing the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission in Section 1 of the state organs for the first time. (북한의 새 헌법 특징 중 하나는 김정은의 권한이 전반적으로 대폭 강화됐다는 점이다. 기존 헌법은 명목상의 최고 주권 기관인 최고인민회의 관련 내용을 국가기구 1절에, 김정은이 맡고 있는 국무위원장 관련 조항은 2절에 뒀다. 새 헌법에서는 그 순서를 바꿔 처음으로 국무위원장을 국가기구 1절에 배치했다.)

The Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, previously defined as the “supreme leader” in the old constitution, is now defined as the “head of state” representing the country in the new constitution. A provision allowing the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission to exercise veto power over laws adopted by the Supreme People’s Assembly was newly added, while the Supreme People’s Assembly’s authority to recall the Chairman was eliminated. The power to receive credentials from foreign ambassadors, previously exercised by the Chairman of the Supreme People’s Assembly Standing Committee, was also changed to the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission’s authority. It is also specified that “key officials” that the Chairman can appoint or dismiss now include the President of the Supreme People’s Assembly and the Premier of the Cabinet. Han Ki-bum, a visiting senior research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, remarked, “This can be seen as aligning Kim Jong Un’s actual power with the constitutional provisions.” (기존 헌법에서 ‘최고영도자’로 규정했던 국무위원장을 새 헌법에서는 국가를 대표하는 ‘국가수반’으로 정의했다. 최고인민회의가 채택한 법령 등에 대해 국무위원장이 거부권을 행사할 수 있다는 조항이 신설된 반면, 최고인민회의가 갖고 있던 국무위원장 소환권은 삭제됐다. 최고인민회의 상임위원장이 행사하던 외국 대사의 신임장 접수도 국무위원장의 권한으로 변경됐다. 국무위원장이 임명 또는 해임할 수 있는 ‘중요간부’에 최고인민회의 의장과 내각총리도 포함된다는 점도 명시됐다. 한기범 아산정책연구원 객원선임연구위원은 “김정은의 실제 권력과 헌법 조문을 일치시킨 것으로 볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

In this constitution, revised after the dispatch of troops to Russia, the scope of the military receiving “special protection from the state and society” has been expanded to include “families of fallen soldiers in overseas military operations.” Additionally, new clauses were added stating that “the state develops defense science and technology” and “establishes a military-first ethos throughout society and thoroughly prepares for a national resistance war.” (러시아 파병 이후 개정된 이번 헌법에서는 “국가와 사회의 특별한 보호”를 받는 군의 범위가 “해외 군사 작전 참전 열사 유가족” 등으로 확대됐다. 또 “국가는 국방 과학 기술을 발전”시키고 “온 사회에 군사 중시 기풍을 세우고 전민 항전(全民 抗戰) 준비를 빈틈 없이 갖추도록 한다”는 조항이 신설됐다.)

Conversely, all socialist free welfare provisions were deleted. Expressions such as “our country without taxes,” “our workers who do not know unemployment,” and “the free medical care system” were removed. The clause stating that the state “provides” for workers’ living conditions was replaced with the phrase “struggles to provide” them. However, preferential measures for women with multiple children, which did not exist previously, were specified. (반면 사회주의 무상 복지 조항은 모두 삭제됐다. “세금이 없어진 우리나라” “실업을 모르는 우리 근로자” “무상치료제” 등의 표현이 삭제됐다. 국가가 근로자의 생활 조건을 “마련해 준다”는 조항은 “마련해 주기 위해 투쟁한다”는 표현으로 대체됐다. 다만 기존에 없던 다자녀 여성에 대한 우대 조치를 명시했다.)

item.title: Candidates in an Uproar… Ruling Party: “The Public Is Unaware of What ‘Withdrawal of Indictment’ Means” (후보들 아우성인데… 與 “국민은 공소취소 뜻 잘 몰라”)
item.description:
Candidates in an Uproar… Ruling Party: “The Public Is Unaware of What ‘Withdrawal of Indictment’ Means” (후보들 아우성인데… 與 “국민은 공소취소 뜻 잘 몰라”)

On the 6th, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Seong-joon stated that regarding the special counsel act designed to allow for the withdrawal of the indictment in the “Lee Jae-myung presidency case” – dubbed the “fabricated indictment” special counsel law – “8 to 9 out of 10 citizens don’t really understand what ‘withdrawal of indictment’ means.” This was interpreted as suggesting that the controversy over the special counsel act would have limited impact on the June 3 local elections. Within the party, voices emerged saying, “Candidates currently campaigning are burning up on the battlefield, and remarks that could spur a last-minute conservative consolidation should not be made.” The Democratic Party, mindful of deteriorating public opinion, indicated that it would discuss whether to push forward with the special counsel act after the local elections. <<> In a radio interview that day, Rep. Park Seong-joon said regarding the special counsel act, “Highly politically engaged individuals know about it,” adding, “(But) when the People Power Party talks about withdrawing the indictment, (the public) has no idea what it’s about.” He further stated, “That’s why this is difficult in terms of election strategy.” Although People Power Party lawmaker Kim Jae-seop, who appeared on the same program, countered, “The public will know well,” and “Everyone around me knows,” Park maintained his stance. The previous day, on Kim Eo-joon’s YouTube channel, Park had also said, “There is no citizen who knows in detail what withdrawing an indictment entails or how it’s done. Legally, it’s a complicated issue.” Rep. Park, serving as the Democratic Party secretary on the National Assembly’s special committee for the “National Investigation into Yoon Seok-yeol’s Political Prosecution Fabricated Indictment,” has led the initiative for this special counsel act. <<> It is known that a significant number of Democratic Party lawmakers on the special investigation committee share Rep. Park’s views and have advocated for swift passage of the special counsel act. One lawmaker from the committee stated, “Rather, our support base is complaining about why we’re delaying the special counsel’s handling.” Another lawmaker representing a constituency in the greater Seoul area remarked, “Over the weekend, I visited my district, and there were no residents talking about withdrawing the indictment,” adding, “It might have an effect in conservative strongholds like Yeongnam, but in the Seoul metropolitan area and elsewhere, it won’t have much impact.” <<> The People Power Party reacted to Rep. Park Seong-joon’s remarks, calling them “an unprecedented outrageous statement” and questioning, “Doesn’t this mean they will push through the bill despite all the controversy?” Ho Jun-seok, spokesperson for the election committee of People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon, stated in a commentary that day, “This is a remark that brands citizens as an ignorant public” and labeled it “an absolutely unacceptable anti-citizen expression.” <<> Democratic Party candidates currently on the campaign trail are reportedly anxious about the potential negative impact of the special counsel act. In particular, candidates from the Yeongnam and greater Seoul areas are said to have appealed to the party leadership, saying, “This could be fatal to the election. You must exercise restraint.” Gangwon Governor candidate Woo Sang-ho said on a radio program that day, “When the Democratic Party has good election momentum, it sabotages itself,” adding, “I really don’t understand why they proposed a special counsel act during such an important election period.” In the conservative stronghold of Gangwon, polls show Woo ahead, but the gap has recently been narrowing. Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Bu-gyeom is also reported to have conveyed the sensitive local sentiment to the party leadership. <<> Other candidates are avoiding mentioning the special counsel act altogether. Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh, when asked about it by reporters that day, declined to answer, saying, “The mayor should focus on people’s livelihoods.” Ha Jeong-woo, a candidate for the Buk-gu Gap by-election for the National Assembly in Busan, also dodged questions about his stance on the special counsel act, telling reporters, “Isn’t that something I can think about once I get to the National Assembly?” He further added, “Wasn’t I not a politician before? I need to focus on the election now,” avoiding the topic. Meanwhile, Han Dong-hoon, running as an independent in the same district, criticized on Facebook, “Do you have to get permission from President Lee Jae-myung or Representative Jeong Cheong-rae to speak about this?” <<> Separately, Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho stated at the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee plenary session that day regarding the special counsel act, “I sympathize with the basic legislative intent, but I hope the scope of authority and investigation targets are decided through parliamentary deliberation.” Minister Jeong also said, “If grounds equivalent to those for a retrial are found, then that should proceed accordingly.” As the Democratic Party plans to discuss the handling of the special counsel act after the local elections, some argue that the investigation into the alleged fabricated indictment should be entrusted to a special counsel, but the decision on whether to withdraw the indictment should be made by the Minister of Justice – who has the authority to direct the Prosecutor General – rather than the special counsel. However, Minister Jeong has consistently stated regarding the withdrawal of the indictment in President Lee’s case that he “has not reviewed it.” (더불어민주당 박성준 의원은 6일 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있도록 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 두고 “시민 10명 중 8~9명은 ‘공소 취소’ 뜻을 잘 모른다”고 했다. 특검법 논란이 6·3 지방선거에 미치는 영향이 제한적이라는 취지로 해석됐다. 당내에서는 “선거를 뛰고 있는 후보들은 전장에서 속이 타들어가고 있는데 막판 보수 결집을 유도할 수 있는 발언을 해선 안된다”는 말이 나왔다. 민주당은 여론 악화를 의식해 지방선거 후 특검 처리 여부를 논의하겠다는 상황이다.)

item.title: Blue House: “US Freedom Operation Suspended, No Need to Review Participation” (靑 “美 프리덤 작전 중단돼 참여 검토 불필요”)
item.description:
Blue House: “US Freedom Operation Suspended, No Need to Review Participation” (靑 “美 프리덤 작전 중단돼 참여 검토 불필요”)

Regarding the HMM (formerly Hyundai Merchant Marine) vessel NAMUHO, which experienced an explosion and fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, the Blue House stated on the 6th that it is “currently being towed.” (호르무즈 해협에서 정박 중 폭발·화재가 발생한 HMM(옛 현대상선) 나무호와 관련해 청와대가 6일 “현재 예인 중”이라고 밝혔다.)

Blue House National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing that day that the NAMUHO is expected to arrive in Dubai around the early morning of the 7th, and “then an investigation team will go there to determine the cause of the explosion.” Director Wi described the explosion on the NAMUHO as “not seeming to clearly be a strike” and added that “there was no flooding or tilting of the vessel.” (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 이날 브리핑에서 나무호가 7일 새벽쯤 두바이에 입항할 것이라며 “그러면 조사팀이 가서 (폭발 원인을) 파악할 예정”이라고 했다. 위 실장은 나무호 폭발에 대해 “피격이 그렇게 확실치는 않은 것 같다”며 “침수라든가, 배가 기울어졌다든가 하는 건 없었다”고 전했다.)

Regarding the ‘Project Freedom’ operation proposed by U.S. President Donald Trump to support transit through the Strait of Hormuz, Director Wi stated, “Since the operation has ended, there is no need for review.” President Trump announced that day that progress in negotiations with Iran had led to a temporary suspension of this operation. (도널드 트럼프 미 대통령이 제안한 호르무즈 통행 지원 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’ 작전과 관련해 위 실장은 “작전이 종료됐기 때문에 검토가 필요하지 않게 됐다”고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 이란과 협상에 진전이 있어 이 작전을 일시 중단한다고 밝혔다.)

However, concerning the multinational maritime coalition ‘Maritime Freedom Initiative’ proposed by the U.S. on the 28th of last month, Director Wi said, “It appears to be a broad approach for stabilizing the strait and ensuring freedom of navigation,” and “we are conducting related reviews.” (다만 미국이 지난달 28일 제안했던 다국적 해상 연합체 ‘해양자유구상’에 대해 위 실장은 “해협의 안정화와 통항의 자유를 위한 폭넓은 접근인 것 같이 보인다”며 “관련 검토를 하고 있다”고 했다.)

◇Despite Blue House’s Cautious Stance on ‘Strike Theory’… Some Suggest Possibility of Iranian Drone Attack (◇靑 ‘피격설’ 신중론에도… 일각 “이란이 드론 공격 가능성”)

Although Blue House National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated regarding the cause of the explosion and fire on the NAMUHO, a cargo ship owned by Korean shipping company HMM, that “it does not seem clearly to be a strike,” even amid this ‘cautious stance’ by the Blue House, analyses from military intelligence circles and others are leaning toward the possibility of an ‘external factor.’ This is because crew members from nearby vessels reportedly heard an ‘explosion sound’ and witnessed a ‘water column’ and ‘spray’ around the time the fire started on the port side of the NAMUHO. A military source said, “If a loud explosion was heard from outside followed by water spray, it is highly likely not due to internal causes.” (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 우리 선사 HMM 소속 화물선 ‘나무호’의 폭발·화재 원인에 대해 “피격이 그렇게 확실치는 않은 것 같다”고 말했지만, 이런 청와대의 ‘신중론’에도 군사 정보 업계 등에서는 ‘외부 요인’ 가능성에 무게를 두는 분석들이 나오고 있다. 인근 선박 선원 등이 나무호 좌현에서 화재가 발생할 무렵 ‘폭발음’을 듣고 ‘물기둥’과 ‘물보라’를 목격한 것으로 전해졌기 때문이다. 군 소식통은 “외부에서 폭음이 들린 뒤 물보라가 생겼다면 내부 원인이 아닐 가능성이 높다”고 했다.)

On the morning of the 4th, when the explosion and fire occurred on the NAMUHO anchored off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the UAE, and the previous day, Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reportedly made radio calls ordering ships in the area to move. Subsequently, the IRGC launched cruise missile and drone attacks toward the UAE. The possibility that the NAMUHO was caught up in this attack is being raised first. (UAE 움알쿠와인 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호에서 폭발·화재가 발생한 4일 오전과 전날 이란 혁명수비대(IRGC)는 이 일대 해상에 있던 선박들에게 이동을 명령하는 무전을 한 것으로 알려졌다. 그 후 이란 혁명수비대는 UAE를 향해 순항미사일·드론 공격을 개시했다. 나무호가 이 공격에 휩쓸렸을 가능성이 우선 거론되고 있다.)

A person affiliated with an overseas military intelligence firm said on the 6th, “Local intelligence sources estimate that the NAMUHO was struck by an Iranian Shahed-136 drone,” adding, “Given the activation of the UAE’s air defense systems at the time, it is highly likely that an Iranian drone attack through the air took place.” A domestic military expert also stated, “If Iran aimed for a ‘low-intensity provocation’ that threatened without breaking the ceasefire with the U.S., the Shahed, which allows for controlled explosive power, might have been more effective than an underwater drone.” (해외에서 활동하는 군사 정보 업체 관계자는 6일 “현지 정보 소식통들은 나무호가 이란의 샤헤드-136 드론에 피격된 것으로 추정하고 있다”며 “당시 아랍에미리트(UAE) 방공망 가동 등을 보면 공중을 통한 이란의 드론 공격 등이 이뤄졌을 가능성이 높다”고 했다. 국내의 한 군사 전문가도 “이란이 미국과의 휴전을 깨지 않으면서 위협을 하는 수준의 ‘저강도 도발’을 목적했다면, 폭발력을 통제할 수 있는 샤헤드가 수중 드론 등보다 더 효과적이었을 수 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier, foreign media reported that UK maritime security firm ‘Vanguard Tech’ analyzed that “the cause of the explosion detected on the port side of the NAMUHO could be an underwater drone or a floating mine.” This seems to suggest the possibility of an underwater drone or mine fragments, considering that a water column and spray were observed during the NAMUHO explosion. No eyewitness accounts of seeing a drone or projectile flying in just before the explosion have been confirmed yet. (앞서 외신들은 영국 해양 안보 업체 ‘뱅가드 테크’가 “나무호 좌현에서 탐지된 폭발의 원인은 수중 드론 또는 부유 기뢰일 가능성이 있다”고 분석했다고 전했다. 나무호 폭발 당시 물기둥과 물보라 등이 목격된 점을 고려할 때, 수중 드론이나 기뢰 파편 등의 가능성이 있다는 취지로 보인다. 나무호 폭발 직전에 날아드는 드론이나 발사체를 봤다는 목격담은 아직까지 확인된 바 없다.)

However, underwater drones pose a significant risk of penetrating the lower hull and sinking the vessel. This is inconsistent with the fact that the NAMUHO’s hull did not flood or list. For this reason, arguments emerge that the possibility of an explosion from a drone flight, such as by a Shahed with an adjustable explosive power via warhead replacement, cannot be ruled out. There is also a suggestion that while the NAMUHO might have been attacked by a Shahed drone, the warhead could have malfunctioned, resulting in only minor damage. (그러나 수중 드론은 배 하부에 구멍을 내 배를 침몰시킬 수 있는 위험성이 크다. 나무호 선체가 침수되거나 기울지는 않았다는 사실과는 맞지 않는 점이 있다. 이 때문에 탄두 교체를 통해 폭발력을 조절할 수 있는 샤헤드 등 드론 비행에 의한 폭발 가능성도 배제할 수 없다는 주장이 나온다. 나무호가 샤헤드 드론 공격을 받았지만, 탄두가 불발해 피해가 경미했을 가능성도 제기된다.)

President Trump, who had insisted on the ‘Iran attack theory’ from the start, also said on the 5th (local time), “They (Korea) had their ship attacked. They were not in the convoy; they decided to go it alone.” This is interpreted as meaning the NAMUHO was attacked by Iran because it attempted to exit the Strait of Hormuz without U.S. protection. However, an HMM official stated that the NAMUHO had been anchored for several days in that location, waiting for the strait to open. (초기부터 ‘이란 공격론’을 주장했던 트럼프 대통령은 5일(현지 시각)에도 “그들(한국)의 선박이 공격당했다. 그들은 선박의 대열에 없었고, 혼자 행동하기로 한 것”이라고 말했다. 나무호가 미국의 보호 없이 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나가려 했기 때문에 이란의 공격을 받았다는 취지로 해석된다. 그러나 나무호는 며칠 전부터 해당 위치에서 해협 개방을 기다리며 닻을 내리고 정박해 있는 상태였다고 HMM 관계자는 전했다.)

The Iranian Embassy in Seoul issued a statement on the 6th, saying, “The Embassy of Iran categorically rejects and strongly denies any claims of the involvement of the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran in incidents related to damage suffered by a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz.” This denies the observation that it could be an Iranian attack. The Korean government also maintains the position that “it is difficult to decide whether it was a strike or not.” However, the Iranian Embassy stated that for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, it is necessary to consult with Iranian authorities, move along designated routes, and fully comply with relevant regulations, including heeding warnings from the Iranian side. (주한이란대사관은 6일 성명을 통해 “이란대사관은 호르무즈 해협에서 한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란 공화국의 군이 개입했다는 모든 주장을 단호하게 거부하고 강력히 부인한다”고 했다. 이란의 공격일 수 있다는 관측을 부인한 것이다. 우리 정부도 “피격인지 아닌지 판단을 내리기 어렵다”는 입장을 유지하고 있다. 다만 이란대사관은 호르무즈 해협을 안전하게 통행하려면 이란 당국과 협의하고, 지정한 항로로 이동해야 하며, 이란 측의 경고에 따르는 등 관련 규정을 완전히 준수해야 한다고 했다.)

Meanwhile, HMM secured a tugboat to move the NAMUHO to Dubai port and began towing operations on that day. The NAMUHO is currently unable to navigate under its own power due to damage to its engine systems from the aftermath of the fire. Once the NAMUHO enters a repair facility at Dubai port, a detailed accident investigation and hull repairs are scheduled to proceed. HMM has already dispatched an investigation team to the site. Personnel from the Korean Register based in Dubai, investigators from the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal dispatched from home, and forensic experts from the National Fire Agency are also scheduled to participate in the investigation. (한편, HMM은 나무호를 두바이항으로 옮길 예인선을 확보해 이날 예인 작업을 시작했다. 현재 나무호는 화재 여파로 기관계통이 손상돼 자력 운항이 불가능한 상황이다. 나무호가 두바이항 내 수리소에 입항하면 정밀 사고 조사와 선체 수리가 진행될 예정이다. HMM은 조사단을 이미 현지로 파견했다. 두바이 현지의 한국선급 인력과 국내에서 파견되는 중앙해양안전심판원 조사관, 소방청 감식 전문가 등도 조사에 참여할 예정이다.)

item.title: "What Has Yoo Jeong-bok Done? I'll Change Incheon the Lee Jae-myung Way" (“유정복 뭘 했나… 이재명식으로 인천 바꿀 것”)
item.description:
"What Has Yoo Jeong-bok Done? I'll Change Incheon the Lee Jae-myung Way" (“유정복 뭘 했나… 이재명식으로 인천 바꿀 것”)

Democratic Party of Korea Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae said in an interview with this newspaper on the 5th, "Just as the Lee Jae-myung administration brought a sense of efficacy to the people through administrative innovation, I will demonstrate a new city administration in Incheon." (더불어민주당 박찬대 인천시장 후보는 지난 5일 본지 인터뷰에서 “이재명 정부가 행정 혁신으로 국민에게 효능감을 준 것처럼 인천에서 새로운 시정을 보여드리겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park emphasized his connection with President Lee. He stated, "Didn't I serve as floor leader during the president's time as the Democratic Party leader, working in tandem as a 'top duo'? For over five years, I've worked in sync with him, even enduring his spittle flying." He added, "By becoming mayor, even amid debates with the president, I will revive Incheon's growth engine through communication with the presidential office and the ruling party." (박 후보는 이 대통령과의 인연을 강조했다. 그는 “저는 대통령의 민주당 대표 시절 원내대표를 지내며 ‘투톱’ 호흡을 맞추지 않았나. 5년 넘게 그분이 침 튀기는 것까지 맞아가면서 손발을 맞춰왔다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대통령과 논쟁이 되는 제가 시장이 돼서 청와대, 여당과의 소통을 통해 인천의 성장 동력을 다시 깨우겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park is aiming to reclaim Incheon from the incumbent People Power Party Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok, who is seeking re-election. Targeting Yoo's eight-year administration, Park said, "Incheon's economic growth rate, which was 6.8% in 2022, fell to a provisional -0.5% last year," calling him "a mayor who poorly conquered Incheon's economy." (박 후보는 연임에 나서는 국민의힘 유정복 현 시장을 상대로 인천 탈환을 노리고 있다. 박 후보는 유 시장의 8년 시정을 겨냥해 “2022년 6.8%였던 인천 경제성장률이 지난해 잠정 -0.5%로 추락했다”며 “인천 경제를 나쁘게 정복한 시장”이라고 했다.)

-Why did you decide to run for mayor of Incheon? (-인천시장에 도전한 이유는.)

"I was born, raised, and studied in Incheon, and I've spent most of my life here. The idea of becoming Incheon's mayor has been with me since my first and second terms as a lawmaker. Moreover, the first task for recreating a Democratic Party administration is winning this local election. If I had won the party leadership election last year (defeating Representative Jeong Cheong-rae), I would have focused on central politics, but that's in the past. I believe my remaining role is to achieve the recapture of local governments." (“인천에서 나고, 자라고, 공부했고, 삶의 대부분을 인천에서 생활했다. 기회가 된다면 인천시장을 해봐야겠다는 생각이 초·재선 국회의원 때부터 있었다. 또한 민주당 정권을 재창출하기 위한 첫 번째 과제가 이번 지방선거 승리다. 작년 당대표 선거에서 (정청래 대표를 꺾고) 승리했다면 중앙 정치를 했겠지만 그건 지나간 일이 됐다. 저한테 남은 역할은 지방정부 탈환을 이뤄내는 것이라고 생각했다.”)

-You're leading in polls. Any thoughts? (-여론조사에서 앞서가고 있는데.)

"Aren't people feeling the negative growth rate and the 2.4 trillion won debt hidden behind Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok's flashy slogans? At the same time, I think there are high expectations for a figure like Park Chan-dae, who has delivered visible results on the national stage. I believe we must win this election overwhelmingly." (“유정복 시장의 화려한 슬로건 뒤에 가려진 성장률 마이너스와 2조4000억원 부채를 체감하고 있는 것 아니겠나. 동시에, 중앙에서 활약하며 눈에 보이는 성과를 만들어 온 박찬대라는 인물에 대해 많은 기대를 걸어주시는 것 같다. 이번 선거에 압도적으로 이겨야 한다고 생각한다.”)

-How would you assess Mayor Yoo's governance? (-유 시장의 시정을 평가한다면.)

"The general assessment of his eight years in the 6th and 8th local administrations is that 'he did nothing for Incheon.' Many pressing issues remained unresolved; he proposed numerous projects to open Incheon's future but failed to deliver results. He said he would achieve a 'Jemulpo Renaissance' with the old downtown development plan, but nothing materialized—only consulting reports came out, earning him the criticism of being the 'consultant market mayor.'" (“민선 6·8기 8년에 대한 대다수의 평가는 ‘인천을 위해 한 게 없다’는 것이다. 많은 현안이 있었는데 무엇 하나 해소한 게 없고, 인천의 미래를 열기 위해 많은 프로젝트를 제시했는데 성과를 내지 못했다. 원도심 개발 계획으로 ‘제물포 르네상스’를 한다고 했는데 아무것도 되지 않았고 용역 보고서만 나와 있어서, ‘용역 시장’이라는 비판을 받고 있다.”)

-What are the pressing issues Incheon faces? (-인천이 당면한 현안은 무엇인가.)

"As a metropolitan area, we suffer from both regulatory constraints and diminishing development opportunities. As the government aims for region-led growth and balanced development, it says we must break away from a single-pole metropolitan area system. But this could tip the balance. With 20 trillion won in central government support over four years for the South Jeolla-Gwangju special administrative integration city, and with similar special cities planned for Daegu-North Gyeongsang, Daejeon-South Chungcheong, and Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang, Incheon needs new plans and strategies to maintain competitiveness and open its future." (“수도권이기 때문에 규제를 당한다는 어려움과 발전 기회가 줄어드는 어려움을 같이 겪고 있다. 정부가 지방 주도 성장, 지역 균형 발전을 이루려 하다 보니, 수도권 1극 체제에서 벗어나야 한다고 하는데, 자칫하면 균형을 잃을 수 있다. 전남광주 행정 통합 특별시에 4년간 20조원의 중앙정부 지원이 이뤄지는데, 앞으로 대구·경북, 대전·충남, 부산·울산·경남까지 이런 통합 특별시가 만들어진다면, 우리 인천이 경쟁력을 유지하고 미래를 열어갈 새로운 계획과 전략이 있어야 한다.”)

-What future strategies does Incheon have? (-인천의 미래 전략은 어떤 게 있나.)

"It's the 'ABC+E' strategy. A is AI—applying AI to Incheon, a logistics hub with aviation, ports, roads, and railways, would boost its competitiveness. B is bio—it should become a mecca for new drug manufacturing. C is culture and content—Incheon shouldn't just be a transit point for K-content but a place for expansion and reproduction. I plan to build a performance stadium accommodating over 50,000 people at the site of Munhak Stadium. E is energy—I will establish an offshore wind farm complex." (“‘ABC+E’ 전략이다. A는 AI(인공지능)로, 항공·항만·도로·철도를 다 갖춘 물류 도시 인천에 AI를 입힌다면 경쟁력을 더 갖출 수 있다. B는 바이오다. 신약 제조의 메카가 돼야 한다. C는 컬처·콘텐츠다. 인천이 K콘텐츠의 경유지가 아니라, 확대 재생산되는 곳이 돼야 한다. 문학경기장 자리에 5만명 이상 들어갈 수 있는 공연 스타디움을 만들겠다. E는 에너지다. 해상 풍력 단지를 조성하겠다.”)

-Your pledge includes an "Emergency Livelihood Recovery 100-Day Project." (-공약으로 ‘긴급 민생 회복 100일 프로젝트’를 내세웠다.)

"Livelihoods are suffering due to high prices and oil costs from the Middle East war. A key Democratic Party policy is local currency, and Incheon has 'IEUM.' I aim to increase the IEUM card monthly limit from 300,000 won to 1 million won, boost the cashback rate from 10% to 15%, and allow fuel costs to be paid with the IEUM card." (“중동 전쟁으로 인한 고물가·고유가로 민생이 어려움을 겪고 있다. 민주당의 핵심 정책이 지역 화폐인데, 인천엔 ‘이음’이 있다. 이음 카드 한도를 월 30만원에서 100만원으로, 캐시백 비율을 10%에서 15%로 늘리고, 유류비도 이음 카드로 결제할 수 있게 하려고 한다.”)

-Mayor Yoo criticizes you for having only served as a lawmaker, lacking administrative experience. (-유 시장은 박 후보가 국회의원만 해서 행정 경험이 없다고 비판한다.)

"It's true Mayor Yoo has extensive experience, but as Incheon, having grown to a population of 3 million, moves toward becoming a leading city in South Korea, outdated past experiences can't be the answer. As a former accountant, I have a solid grasp of the real economy, and rather than just waiting for consulting reports in an office, I'll find answers in the field." (“유 시장이 경험이 많은 것은 사실이지만, 인구 300만으로 성장한 인천이 대한민국을 선도하는 도시로 나아가는 데 과거의 낡은 경험이 답이 될 수 없다. 저는 회계사 출신으로 실물 경제를 잘 알고, 사무실에서 용역 보고서만 기다리는 것이 아니라 현장에서 답을 찾을 것이다.”)

-Can you describe your unique strengths? (-박 후보만의 강점을 말해달라.)

"I have worked in sync with the president. Also, during last year's Democratic Party leadership election, didn't about 150 out of 170 lawmakers support me? I am the right person to manage city affairs through my ability to communicate with the president, the government, and the legislature." (“대통령과 호흡을 맞춰왔다는 것이다. 또 작년 민주당 당대표 선거 때 의원 170명 중 150여 명이 저를 지지하지 않았나. 내가 대통령, 정부, 입법부와 소통하는 능력을 통해 시정을 풀어갈 적임자다.”)

-The political scene is in turmoil over the 'manipulated prosecution' special counsel law, which allows for the dismissal of charges in the president's case. What's your stance? (-정치권이 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있게 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법 때문에 시끄럽다. 입장은 뭔가.)

"Through the National Assembly's parliamentary investigation, specific facts regarding suspicions of manipulated investigations and prosecutions in the president's case have been revealed. It is natural to uncover the truth through a special counsel. However, regarding the specific timing and procedures for handling the special counsel law, it is a priority to listen to the public's voice. A decision should be made after forming a national consensus." (“국회 국정조사를 통해 대통령의 사건의 조작 수사·기소 의혹이 구체적 사실로 드러났다. 특검을 통해 진상을 규명하는 것이 당연하다. 다만 특검법 처리의 구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 국민의 목소리를 경청하는 것이 우선이다. 국민적 공감대를 형성한 뒤 결정해야 한다.”)

-Finally, what do you want to say to Incheon citizens? (-마지막으로 인천시민에게 하고 싶은 말은.)

"When I announced my candidacy, I thought about throwing myself into the Incheon sea like New York Mayor Eric Adams did. I am Park Chan-dae, nurtured by Incheon citizens. I have no other thoughts but to devote my entire being and all my capabilities to Incheon. I will not waver or look left and right." (“출마 선언할 때 조란 맘다니 뉴욕시장이 그랬던 것처럼 인천 앞바다에 몸을 한번 던져볼까 싶었다. 인천시민들께서 키워주신 박찬대다. 이 한 몸 던져 모든 역량을 인천에 쏟아붓겠다는 생각 외에 다른 생각을 하고 있지 않다. 좌고우면하지 않겠다”)

☞Who is Park Chan-dae? (☞박찬대는 누구)

Born in Incheon, he graduated from Dongincheon High School and Inha University's Business Administration program. After working as a certified public accountant, he was elected in the 2016 general election for Incheon's Yeonsu-gu District A, winning three consecutive terms there. He served as floor leader during President Lee Jae-myung's tenure as Democratic Party leader, rising as a key member of the pro-Lee faction. After the president's presidential campaign, he served as acting party leader and general election committee chairman. (인천에서 태어나 동인천고, 인하대 경영학과를 졸업했다. 공인회계사로 일하다 2016년 총선 때 인천 연수갑에서 당선된 뒤 이 지역에서 내리 3선을 했다. 이재명 대통령의 민주당 대표 시절 원내대표를 지내며 친명 핵심으로 부상했다. 대통령의 대선 출마 이후엔 당대표 직무대행, 총괄상임선거대책위원장을 지냈다.)

item.title: Three Self-Owned Moves That Shook the Ruling Party’s Landslide Victory Narrative (여권 압승론 스스로 흔든 세 가지 자충수)
item.description:
Three Self-Owned Moves That Shook the Ruling Party’s Landslide Victory Narrative (여권 압승론 스스로 흔든 세 가지 자충수)

With less than a month until the local elections, a seismic shift is occurring in a race where the ruling party was once predicted to dominate overwhelmingly. While the opposition, intoxicated by talk of a landslide victory, repeatedly made self-inflicted mistakes, a narrative of judging the administration has begun to emerge. (지방선거가 한 달도 남지 않은 상황에서 여당의 압도적 우세가 점쳐졌던 선거 구도에 지각 변동이 일어나고 있습니다. 지방선거 압승론에 취해 있던 야권이 잇단 자충수를 두는 사이 정권 심판론이 대두하기 시작한 것입니다.)

While support for the ruling party has weakened among swing voters, conservative voters who had previously defected in disappointment from the People Power Party are regrouping, seen across various regions. In political circles, a strong interpretation is emerging that this is a political backlash triggered by President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel to dismiss the indictment. (중도층에서 여권 지지세가 약해진 반면 국민의힘에 실망해 이탈해 있던 보수층은 재결집하는 모습이 곳곳에서 감지되고 있습니다. 정치권에선 이재명 대통령과 민주당의 공소 취소 특검이 불러온 정치적 역풍이라는 해석이 유력하게 나옵니다.)

It was not the opposition but the ruling party’s own arrogance and self-inflicted blunders that shook the narrative of a landslide victory. The first is the fabricated indictment parliamentary inquiry and the special counsel for dropping the indictment, pushed forward to grant a pardon to President Lee Jae-myung’s case. (여권 압승론을 흔든 것은 야당이 아니라 여권 스스로의 자만과 자충수였습니다. 첫째는 이재명 대통령 사건에 면죄부를 주기 위해 밀어붙여온 조작 기소 국정조사와 공소 취소용 특검입니다.)

Even if there are unjust aspects to President Lee’s case, public opinion is rising that shaking the very foundations of the criminal and judicial system to grant a self-pardon is going too far. It’s hard to avoid criticism that the ruling party has become arrogant, intoxicated by approval ratings. (이 대통령 사건에 아무리 억울한 점이 있다 하더라도 형사·사법 체계의 근간을 흔들면서 셀프 면죄부를 주려는 것은 도를 지나쳤다는 여론이 비등합니다. 지지율에 취해 오만해졌다는 비판을 피하기 힘듭니다.)

Although President Lee belatedly issued a directive to slow down, the essence of pushing forward with the special counsel remains largely unchanged. President Lee himself said, “Public consensus has formed on the need for a special counsel investigation (for dropping the indictment),” adding, “Uncovering the truth is a must.” While the timing may be adjusted, the intent to proceed with dropping the indictment through the special counsel remains clear. (이 대통령이 뒤늦게 속도 조절 지침을 내렸지만, 특검 강행이라는 본질은 크게 달라지지 않았습니다. 이 대통령 스스로도 “(공소취소용) 특검 수사 필요성에 대해 국민 공감대가 형성됐다”며 “진실 규명은 반드시 해야 할 일”이라고 했습니다. 시기 조절은 하겠지만 특검을 통한 공소 취소는 그대로 밀어붙이겠다는 뜻입니다.)

Since the proposal of the special counsel law to drop the indictment, the opposition has strongly protested. Not only the opposition leadership but also various local government candidate have issued successive condemnation statements. As opposition to the special counsel grows, especially in the Yeongnam region, the narrative of judging the administration has begun to surface. The once-stalled joint struggle front and electoral alliance between the People Power Party and the Reform Party have also begun in earnest. The special counsel is effectively rallying the conservative base and injecting energy back into the opposition, which was previously in disarray. (공소취소용 특검법 발의 이후 야권은 강하게 반발하고 있습니다. 야당 지도부는 물론이고 여러 단체장 후보들도 잇따라 규탄 성명을 냈습니다. 영남을 중심으로 특검 반대 여론이 높아지면서 정권 심판론도 고개를 들기 시작했습니다. 그동안 지지부진했던 국민의힘과 개혁신당 간의 공동 투쟁 전선과 선거 연대 움직임도 본격화하고 있습니다. 특검이 보수층을 결집시켜 지리멸렬했던 야권에 되레 힘을 불어넣어주는 모양새입니다.)

The second self-inflicted blunder is the controversy over abolishing the long-term holding special deduction for real estate. After President Lee first announced the plan to scrap the deduction for long-term holders via X (Twitter), complaints grew in Seoul and the metropolitan area, with voices saying, “Even single-homeowners will face a capital gains tax bombshell.” (두 번째 자충수는 부동산 장기보유특별공제 폐지 논란입니다. 이 대통령이 X(트위터)를 통해 처음 장기 보유자 공제 폐지 방침을 밝힌 이후 서울과 수도권에선 “1주택자에게도 양도세 폭탄이 떨어질 것”이란 불만의 목소리가 커졌습니다.)

When President Lee initially announced the policy to eliminate the capital gains tax reduction for multi-homeowners, there was much positive reaction in the market. This led to an increase in apartment listings and a drop in home prices in Seoul and the metropolitan area. However, anything taken to extremes becomes a problem. When President Lee then pushed forward with abolishing the long-term holding special deduction for single-homeowners, a wave of backlash grew among single-homeowners in the capital region. Critics argued it aimed to label even single-homeowners as speculators and impose punitive taxes. (이 대통령이 다주택자에 대한 양도세 감면 폐지 방침을 밝혔을 때만 해도 시장에선 긍정적 반응이 많았습니다. 서울과 수도권 지역의 아파트 매물이 늘고 집값이 떨어지는 효과도 나타났습니다. 하지만 무엇이든 도가 지나치면 문제가 됩니다. 이 대통령이 내친김에 1주택자 장기보유특별공제 폐지론을 꺼내자 수도권 1주택자들 사이에선 반발 기류가 커졌습니다. 1주택 보유자까지 투기로 몰아 징벌적 세금을 매기려 한다는 것입니다.)

Critics point out that while multi-homeowners are a small minority, single-homeowners account for nearly half of all households—a fact that seems to have been overlooked. Additionally, as the likelihood grows that ordinary people and young people who took on debt to buy a home could face a tax bombshell, concerns are rising that even the ruling party’s traditional supporters may defect. (다주택자는 극소수이지만 1주택자는 전체 가구 수의 절반에 가까울 만큼 많다는 것을 간과했다는 지적이 나옵니다. 또 빚을 내 내 집 마련에 나섰던 서민·청년층까지 세금 폭탄을 맞을 가능성이 커지자 여권의 전통적 지지층까지 이반할 수 있다는 우려가 나옵니다.)

The ruling party tried to downplay it, saying “it hasn’t been officially reviewed,” but the controversy refuses to die down as President Lee repeatedly expresses his intent. A heated exchange over real estate responsibility is even unfolding between Seoul mayoral candidates Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon. Within the ruling party, assessments emerge that “the controversy over scrapping the long-term holding deduction is a vote-losing factor that doesn’t help the election.” (여당에선 “공식 검토한 게 아니다”라고 진화했지만, 이 대통령이 거듭 의지를 밝히면서 논란은 사그라들지 않고 있습니다. 정원오·오세훈 서울시장 후보 간에는 치열한 부동산 책임 공방까지 벌어지고 있습니다. 여권 내부에선 “장특공 폐지 논란은 선거에 도움이 안 되는 감표 요인”이라는 평가가 나옵니다.)

The third self-inflicted blunder is inappropriate remarks and verbal gaffes by ruling party figures. Notable examples include Representative Jeong Cheong-rae’s “oppa” comment and Busan mayoral candidate Ha Jung-woo’s “hand wiping” controversy. After Ha, who served as a senior presidential secretary for AI, belatedly announced his candidacy following controversy, a scandal erupted as soon as he arrived in the region: he was seen shaking hands with residents and then wiping his hand. Ha explained it was because his hand was numb, but the opposition attacked fiercely, saying, “Were the voters’ hands dirty?” “Are you treating residents like bugs?” “Isn’t this the arrogant elitism of the chosen few?” (세 번째 자충수는 여권 인사들의 부적절한 언행과 말실수입니다. 대표적인 것이 정청래 대표의 ‘오빠’ 발언과 하정우 부산시장 후보의 ‘손 털기’ 논란입니다. 청와대 AI 수석이었던 하 후보가 논란 끝에 뒤늦게 출마 선언을 했지만 지역에 내려오자마자 불거진 것이 주민들과 악수 후 손을 털었다는 구설수였습니다. 하 수석은 손이 저려서 그랬다고 해명했지만, 야권에선 “유권자의 손이 더러웠던 거냐” “주민을 벌레 취급하느냐” “엘리트의 오만한 선민의식 아니냐”고 맹공을 퍼부었습니다.)

In the midst of this, as Representative Jeong accompanied candidate Ha through the Buk-gu Gap district in Busan, he told a first-grade elementary school girl, “Try calling him ‘Jeong-woo oppa,’ say ‘oppa’,” sparking major controversy. Criticisms of child sexual harassment and human rights violations emerged. While Jeong quickly apologized, it has damaged not only Ha’s campaign but also the entire Busan election. Subsequently, other ruling party candidates have made remarks that disparage civil servants or belittle Park Chung-hee. This too is seen as a self-inflicted blunder born of ruling party arrogance and complacency. (이런 와중에 정 대표가 하정우 후보와 동행해 부산북갑 지역을 도는 과정에서 초등학교 1학년 여자 어린이에게 “정우 오빠, 오빠(라고) 해 봐요”라고 한 발언이 큰 논란을 일으켰습니다. 아동 성희롱이라는 비판과 함께 인권 침해 논란까지 일었습니다. 정 대표가 급하게 사과했지만 하 후보는 물론이고 부산 선거에까지 타격을 주고 있습니다. 이후에도 공무원 비하나 박정희 폄하 논란을 일으키는 여권 후보들의 발언이 이어지고 있습니다. 이 또한 여권의 자만과 방심이 불러온 자충수라는 평가입니다.)

As these self-inflicted blunders accumulate, the elections in Busan, Gyeongnam, and Daegu have shifted within just a week or two from ruling party dominance to a tight race within the margin of error. A trend is emerging where conservative voters, who had scattered in disappointment with the People Power Party, are regrouping. In Seoul, where real estate policy controversy has grown, the approval gap between the ruling and opposition parties is gradually narrowing. (이런 자충수들이 쌓이면서 부산·경남과 대구 선거는 불과 한두 주 사이에 여권 우세에서 오차 범위 내 접전 양상으로 변했습니다. 국민의힘에 실망해 흩어졌던 보수층이 다시 결집하는 기류도 나타나고 있습니다. 부동산 정책 논란이 커진 서울 지역도 여야 간 지지율 격차가 점점 줄어들고 있습니다.)

They say you lose an election or a golf game the moment you look up. The Democratic Party, which had predicted a sweep of 15 out of 16 metropolitan governments except for Gyeongbuk, is now rattled by this sudden shift in the atmosphere. Some fear they might even have to hand over all five Yeongnam regions. Predictions also suggest that Seoul, Gangwon, and the Chungcheong region could come under the influence of the conservative consolidation wave. (선거와 골프는 고개를 쳐드는 순간 망한다고 합니다. 전국 16개 광역 단체 중 경북을 제외한 15개 싹쓸이를 예상했던 민주당은 최근 갑작스러운 이상 기류에 당혹해하고 있습니다. 일각에선 영남 5곳을 다 넘겨주는 것 아니냐고 불안해합니다. 서울과 강원, 충청권까지 보수 결집 바람의 영향권에 들어갈 수 있다는 전망도 나옵니다.)

The electoral landscape, once dominated by the narrative of judging the insurrection, has shifted to a mix of judging the administration and judging the opposition. However, experts assess that given the previously huge gap in approval ratings between the ruling and opposition parties, and the unresolved internal strife within the People Power Party, the situation hasn’t yet turned things around. Ultimately, whether the ruling party makes further mistakes or internal divisions within the People Power Party reignite will be key variables. (내란 심판론이 지배했던 선거판도 정권 심판론과 야당 심판론이 혼재하는 양상으로 변했습니다. 하지만 그동안 여야 지지율 격차가 워낙 컸던 데다 국민의힘 내분도 정리되지 못한 상태라 아직 판세가 뒤집어질 정도까지는 아니라고 전문가들은 평가합니다. 결국 여권에서 또 다른 실수가 이어지느냐, 국힘 내부 분란이 재연되느냐가 중요한 변수가 될 것으로 보입니다.)

The special counsel law to drop the indictment was proposed on the 30th of last month, led by lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, a former lawyer for President Lee. It drew criticism as a “self-pardon law” crafted by a lawyer for his client. In response, President Lee, just four days after the bill’s proposal, on the 4th, ordered a slowdown, asking for “public opinion gathering and deliberation.” This was likely due to his assessment that it would severely harm the local elections. (공소취소 특검법은 지난달 30일 이 대통령 변호인 출신인 이건태 의원이 주도해 발의했습니다. 변호인이 의뢰인을 위해 만든 셀프 면죄부법이라는 비판이 나왔습니다. 그러자 이 대통령은 법안 발의 나흘 만인 지난 4일 “국민 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 달라”며 속도 조절을 주문했습니다. 지방선거에 미치는 악영향이 그만큼 크다고 판단했기 때문일 것입니다.)

As the special counsel to drop the indictment emerged as an election issue, polls in Busan and Daegu showed the gap in approval between ruling and opposition candidates narrowing to within the margin of error. The ruling party’s advantage turned into a close race in just one week. The gap in support for Seoul mayoral candidates is also narrowing. (공소취소 특검이 선거 이슈로 떠오르면서 부산·대구 여론조사에서 여야 후보 간 지지율 격차는 오차 범위로 줄었습니다. 여권 우세가 불과 1주일 사이에 접전으로 바뀐 것입니다. 서울시장 후보 지지율 격차도 좁혀지고 있습니다.)

Experts and both parties alike analyze this as the fallout from pushing the special counsel to drop the indictment. Some ruling party candidates have publicly requested that the special counsel law be postponed until after the elections. This is also why President Lee issued a directive to slow down. The ruling party seems startled by the backlash from the indictment dismissal. It’s akin to trying to remove a wart but ending up with a bigger one. The sense of crisis is considerable. (전문가와 여야 모두 공소취소 특검 강행의 여파라고 분석하고 있습니다. 일부 여권 후보들은 공개적으로 “특검법을 선거 후로 미뤄 달라”고 요청했습니다. 이 대통령이 속도 조절 지침을 내린 것도 이 때문입니다. 공소취소로 인한 역풍에 여권이 화들짝 놀란 분위기입니다. 혹 떼려다 혹 붙였다고나 할까요. 위기감이 상당합니다.)

However, the ruling party hasn’t abandoned the special counsel to drop the indictment. President Lee has clearly stated his intention to push forward, claiming that public consensus has formed around the special counsel itself. The Democratic Party leadership has decided to hold a two-week deliberation period over the next 20 days. This appears to be a strategy to defuse the backlash, or “weather the storm.” (하지만 여권이 공소취소 특검을 포기한 게 아닙니다. 이 대통령은 특검 자체에 대해선 국민 공감대가 형성됐다며 추진 입장을 분명히 밝혔습니다. 민주당 지도부는 앞으로 20일 동안 숙려 기간을 갖기로 했습니다. 역풍을 잠재우기 위한 바람 빼기 전략으로 보입니다. 소나기는 피해가겠다는 것이죠.)

The problem is the date 20 days later: the end of May. Some pro-Lee figures have said they will discuss whether to process it then—essentially deciding based on the election landscape. There is underlying anxiety that there’s no guarantee Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and the pro-Jeong faction will process the special counsel law after the elections. But if they push it through, it could become the biggest negative factor in the final stages of the election. Even if it’s a top priority for the president, it won’t be easy. Floor leader Han Byung-do has indicated a plan to handle it after the local elections. (문제는 20일 후인 5월 말입니다. 일부 친명 인사들은 그때 처리 여부를 논의하겠다고 했습니다. 선거 판세를 보고 결정하겠다는 것인데요. 선거 후엔 정청래 대표와 친청 진영이 특검법을 처리한다는 보장이 없다는 불안감이 깔려 있습니다. 하지만 특검법을 강행하면 선거 막판 최대 악재가 될 겁니다. 아무리 대통령 관심사항이라 해도 쉽지 않습니다. 한병도 원내대표는 지방선거 이후 처리하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔습니다.)

Just a short while ago, the political atmosphere was dominated by the narrative of judging the insurrection against the Yoon Seok-youl government and judging the opposition against Representative Jang Dong-hyuk. The anger and disappointment over the People Power Party’s repeated regression and infighting were that significant. (얼마 전만 해도 정치권에선 윤석열 정부에 대한 내란 심판론, 장동혁 대표에 대한 야당 심판론이 지배하는 분위기였습니다. 국민의힘의 잇단 퇴행과 내분에 대한 분노와 실망감이 그만큼 컸습니다.)

But the atmosphere changed when the ruling party recklessly pushed through a parliamentary inquiry and pressured for a special counsel to drop the indictment in President Lee’s case. Particularly in the Yeongnam region and among conservatives, criticism grew that “the effort to acquit the president is too blatant” and “the ruling party is acting arrogantly despite major constitutional controversy.” (그런데 여권이 이 대통령 사건 공소 취소를 위해 무리하게 국정조사를 강행하고 특검까지 밀어붙이자 기류가 달라졌습니다. 영남과 보수층을 중심으로 “대통령 무죄 만들기가 너무 노골적이다” “위헌 논란이 큰데 여권이 안하무인이다”라는 비판이 커졌습니다.)

They say in elections, arrogance leads to defeat. There are talks that “the ruling party, leading unilaterally, got drunk on approval ratings and made reckless moves” and that “the special counsel to drop the indictment gave scattered conservatives, who fragmented after the martial law, impeachment, and election defeat, a cause to regroup and head to the polls.” (선거에선 오만하면 진다고 합니다. “여권이 일방적으로 앞서가다 보니 지지율에 취해서 무리수를 둔 것 아니냐” “계엄·탄핵·대선 패배를 거치며 뿔뿔이 흩어졌던 보수층이 다시 결집해서 투표장에 나올 명분을 공소 취소 특검이 줬다”는 얘기가 나옵니다.)

The People Power Party appears to be using this special counsel as a catalyst to pursue an alliance with the opposition. On the 5th, following the 4th, candidates from the People Power Party and the Reform Party declared a nationwide resistance movement to stop the ruling party’s judicial coup. They seem to be gearing up for an electoral alliance under the banner of fighting the administration. The special counsel appears to have provided both justification and momentum for the opposition alliance. (국민의힘은 이번 특검을 계기로 야권 연대에 나서는 분위기입니다. 4일에 이어 5일에도 국민의힘과 개혁신당 후보들은 여권의 사법 쿠데타를 막겠다며 범국민 저항 운동을 선언했습니다. 대여 투쟁을 명분으로 선거 연대에 시동을 거는 듯합니다. 특검이 야권 연대에 명분과 동력을 준 모양새입니다.)

In Seoul, talks of a single candidacy are emerging between People Power Party’s candidate Oh Se-hoon and Reform Party’s candidate Kim Jung-chul, and in Gyeonggi, between People Power Party’s candidate Yang Hyang-ja and Reform Party’s candidate Jo Eung-cheon. While not an easy feat, if successful, it could significantly impact the elections in the capital region. (서울에선 국힘 오세훈 후보와 개혁신당 김정철 후보, 경기에선 국힘 양향자 후보와 개혁신당 조응천 후보 간 단일화 논의가 시작되는 기류입니다. 쉬운 일은 아니지만 만일 성사된다면 수도권 선거에 상당한 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.)

During the last presidential election, if you combined the approval ratings of the People Power Party’s candidate Kim Moon-soo and the Reform Party’s candidate Lee Jun-seok, it was higher than that of President Lee Jae-myung. If a tight race unfolds in Seoul, a unified opposition candidate could be a decisive variable. (지난 대선 때 국힘 김문수 후보와 개혁신당 이준석 후보의 지지율을 합치면 이재명 대통령보다 높았습니다. 서울에서 박빙의 승부가 펼쳐질 경우 야권 후보 단일화는 승부를 가르는 핵심 변수가 될 것입니다.)

Three election issues have recently influenced public sentiment: first, the special counsel to drop the indictment; second, the controversy over abolishing the long-term holding special deduction for real estate; and third, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae’s “oppa” remark and candidate Ha Jung-woo’s hand-wiping controversy. All three have strong characteristics of self-inflicted blunders by the ruling party, acting as negatives for them and positives for the opposition. (최근 민심에 영향을 미친 선거 이슈는 3가지인데요. 첫째는 공소취소 특검, 둘째는 부동산 장기보유특별공제 폐지 논란, 셋째는 정청래 대표의 오빠 발언과 하정우 후보의 손털기 논란입니다. 세 가지 모두 여권발 자충수의 성격이 강합니다. 또 여권엔 악재, 야권엔 호재로 작용하고 있습니다.)

As a result, the race in the Yeongnam region has turned into a tight contest, and that wave is partially affecting Seoul along the Gyeongbu line. The opposition is issuing daily condemnation statements to leverage the special counsel for dropping the indictment into a narrative of judging the administration. A fierce debate over real estate policy is underway between Seoul mayoral candidates. The controversy over Representative Jeong’s “oppa” remark has also sparked heated debate about gender sensitivity. (이 때문에 영남권 판세는 초접전 양상으로 바뀌었고, 그 바람이 경부선을 타고 서울에까지 일부 영향을 주고 있습니다. 야권에선 공소취소 특검을 정권 심판론으로 끌고 가기 위해 연일 규탄 성명을 내고 있습니다. 서울시장 후보 간에는 부동산 정책 공방이 치열하게 벌어지고 있습니다. 정 대표의 ‘오빠’ 발언을 놓고 성인지 감수성 논란도 뜨겁습니다.)

The ruling party still claims they can win everywhere except a few areas in Yeongnam, arguing that the insurrection frame and the opposition-judging frame are so solid that the special counsel and real estate controversies can’t overturn them. However, the opposition hopes to turn the tables in all five Yeongnam regions, Seoul, Gangwon, and parts of Chungcheong. They believe that if a wind for judging the administration blows and conservatives even rally, the election atmosphere could shift dramatically. Whether the narrative of judgment will continue to target the opposition or change direction toward the ruling party will likely be the key to victory or defeat. (여권에선 그래도 영남 몇 군데를 빼곤 다 이길 수 있다고 얘기합니다. 내란 프레임, 야당 심판 프레임이 워낙 견고해 특검과 부동산 논란으로 뒤집기는 힘들다는 겁니다. 하지만 야권에선 영남 5곳과 서울·강원, 충청 일부까지 역전시킬 수 있다고 기대합니다. 정권 심판 바람이 일고 보수층까지 결집하면 선거 분위기가 급변할 수 있다는 겁니다. 심판론이 예전처럼 야권을 향할 것이냐, 여권으로 방향을 틀 것이냐가 선거 승패의 관건이 될 것으로 보입니다.)

item.title: Lee Won-taek, suspected of having a 720,000 won meal paid for, appears at police station… denies allegations, calling it a "primary election scheme" (‘72만원 식사비 대납’ 의혹 이원택 경찰 출석… “경선용 기획” 혐의 부인)
item.description:
Lee Won-taek, suspected of having a 720,000 won meal paid for, appears at police station… denies allegations, calling it a "primary election scheme" (‘72만원 식사비 대납’ 의혹 이원택 경찰 출석… “경선용 기획” 혐의 부인)

Lee Won-taek, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for North Jeolla Province governor, who is accused of having a provincial councilor who was present at a meal with young party members pay for the meal, appeared at the police station on the 7th. The candidate flatly denied the allegations, stating, "It was not a case of having the meal paid for, but a false scheme designed to influence the primary election." <<> Candidate Lee arrived at the North Jeolla Provincial Police Agency at around 9:20 AM as the accused, accompanied by his lawyer, and claimed, "The truth is being revealed based on the statements of the attendees," adding, "The facts and truth will be clearly distinguished through today's investigation." <<> Questions also followed regarding his conflict with Kim Gwan-young, the current North Jeolla Province governor and his rival within the party. Previously, Governor Kim had taken a drastic step by stating he would retire from politics if the so-called 'insurrection allegations' raised by Candidate Lee turned out to be true, leading to his own indictment. In response to reporters' questions about what Candidate Lee would do if Governor Kim received a no-charge ruling, he said, "It's difficult to answer because it's a question based on a hypothetical," but also stated, "I merely raised reasonable suspicions based on objective data. Please wait for the special counsel's investigation," as he headed to the investigation room. <<> Candidate Lee is accused of having Kim Seul-ji, a North Jeolla provincial councilor from the same party who accompanied him, pay the total meal cost of 727,000 won after having a meal that doubled as a discussion with local young party members at a restaurant in Jeongeup City on November 29th of last year. Article 115 of the Public Official Election Act (Restriction on Third-Party Donations) prohibits acts of indirectly donating through a third party when a candidate cannot directly donate. <<> This gathering was organized right after Candidate Lee held a press conference at the North Jeolla Provincial Council to officially announce his candidacy for the June 3rd local elections' North Jeolla Province governor position. As the so-called 'meal payment uproar' erupted, Candidate Lee's side explained, "We handed 150,000 won in cash to Councilor Kim for our portion (the candidate and his aides) and left the gathering early," adding, "We had no idea at all that Councilor Kim paid the entire bill using the council's business promotion funds and her own money." <<> Through today's investigation, the police plan to intensively examine whether Candidate Lee violated the Public Official Election Act and the intentionality behind the alleged meal payment. (청년 당원들과 식사 자리에서 동석한 도의원에게 밥값을 대신 내게 한 혐의를 받는 더불어민주당 이원택 전북도지사 후보가 7일 경찰에 출석했다. 이 후보는 “식사비 대납이 아니라 경선에 영향을 미치기 위한 허위 기획”이라며 혐의를 전면 부인했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] MBK Takes Action to Address US Investment Review Body… Conscious of Controversy Over Chinese Capital in Korea Zinc Dispute ([단독] MBK, 美투자심의 기구 대응 나서… 고려아연 분쟁 속 中자본 논란 의식했나)
item.description:
[Exclusive] MBK Takes Action to Address US Investment Review Body… Conscious of Controversy Over Chinese Capital in Korea Zinc Dispute ([단독] MBK, 美투자심의 기구 대응 나서… 고려아연 분쟁 속 中자본 논란 의식했나)

Amid the management rights battle between Korea Zinc Chairman Choi Yoon-beom’s side and the private equity firm MBK Partners-Young Poong alliance over the world’s largest nonferrous metals company, it was confirmed on the 6th that MBK Partners has appointed a new lobbyist to respond to the U.S. Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS). As China attempts to weaponize resources, Korea Zinc, alongside the Department of War (Department of Defense), has launched the so-called ‘Project Crucible’ to build a $7.4 billion (approximately 10.7 trillion won) integrated critical mineral smelter in Clarksville, Tennessee. Meanwhile, concerns have been raised in U.S. political circles that MBK Partners, which is eyeing management control of Korea Zinc, has received investments from some Chinese capital sources, including China Investment Corporation (CIC). <<> According to records disclosed by the U.S. Senate under the Lobbying Disclosure Act (LDA), MBK Partners has appointed ‘The McKeon Group’ of Alexandria, Virginia, as a lobbyist to represent its interests. The entity commissioning the lobbying is listed as the Tokyo office, one of MBK Partners’ key hubs as East Asia’s largest private equity fund, leading buyout (management rights acquisition) investments in Japan. The McKeon Group is recognized in the Washington D.C. lobbying market for its specialization in defense and security. Its CEO, Howard P. McKeon, a former chairman of the House Armed Services Committee and Education and the Workforce Committee, is known for having a solid congressional network. The lobbying purpose is explicitly stated as “Matters related to CFIUS.” <<> CFIUS, chaired by the Secretary of the Treasury and involving 16 agencies including the State Department and the Department of Defense, is a cross-governmental body that reviews risks to national security posed by foreign investments in U.S. companies. It actively tracks not only voluntary filings but also unreported investment transactions to investigate potential national security threats. If security risks are not resolved, it can recommend that the President block a transaction or void one already completed. Amid the rivalry with China, it is increasingly applying strict standards. The lobbying purpose was specified as ‘foreign investment in the Tennessee smelter,’ with the MBK-Young Poong alliance criticizing the investment as Chairman Choi’s ‘mobilization of a white knight.’ The management rights dispute between the two sides is also intensifying in Washington D.C., where Korea Zinc has emerged as a major player in the lobbying market by successively hiring top-performing lobbying firms under the Trump administration. ‘Ballard Partners’ by Bryan Ballard, known to have direct access to President Donald Trump, and ‘Mercury Public Affairs (MPA),’ where influential White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles previously worked, are actively representing Korea Zinc.
